source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The migrated Account Hub labels use the shared badge component, but their consumer still controls recommendation visibility. The controller marks the current incoming type as recommended-protocol. CSS shows regular badges for that class and excludes experimental badges from the recommendation gate. Settings retain the regular experimental variant after review, while the extension label retains the inverted variant. The changed test asserts POP3 badge visibility only; this is not a rendering or accessibility result.
title: Badge consumers keep recommendation visibility separate from experimental warnings
